data.name: Elidius
data.gender_notes: Elidius is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Latin 'Elatus' (exalted) and 'Deus' (God). The name Elidius signifies 'God's man' or 'God's exalted one'. This name was given to those who were devoted to God and held a high spiritual or moral standing. The name Elidius carries the meaning “God's man” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Elidius usually hope their child will grow to embody god's man and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name of deep devotion and commitment to God.
data.etymology: Elidius belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's man.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Elidius total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_hebrew.name: אלידיוס
in_hebrew.meaning: אלידיוס הוא שם שמשמעותו אלוהים הוא עזר
in_hebrew.long_meaning: אלידיוס הוא שם שמקורו בשפה היוונית ונמצא בשימוש בקרב הנוצרים. משמעותו היא 'אלוהים הוא עזר' או 'אלוהים הוא עוזרי', והוא מורכב מהמילים 'אל' (אלוהים) ו-'ידיוס' (עזר). שם זה נמצא בשימוש בקרב הנוצרים בימי הביניים ועד ימינו.

in_greek.name: Ελιδίος
in_greek.long_meaning: Ελιδίος είναι ένα όνομα που προέρχεται από την ελληνική γλώσσα και χρησιμοποιείται από τους Χριστιανούς. Η σημασία του είναι 'Θεός είναι βοηθός' ή 'Θεός είναι ο βοηθός μου', και αποτελείται από τις λέξεις 'Ελ' (Θεός) και '-ίδιον' (βοηθός). Αυτό το όνομα χρησιμοποιήθηκε από τους Χριστιανούς κατά τον Μεσαίωνα και μέχρι σήμερα.

in_latin.name: Elidius
in_latin.meaning: Elidius means God is my helper
in_latin.long_meaning: Elidius is a name derived from Greek and used by Christians. It means 'God is my helper' or 'God is my aid', composed of 'El' (God) and 'idius' (helper). This name was used by Christians during the Middle Ages and up to the present day, reflecting a deep spiritual significance.

in_english.name: Elidius
in_english.meaning: Elidius means God is helper or aid

It is associated with virtues like faith, trust, and reliance on God.
